_comment: Dashboard user registry for apps/agent-runtime — copy to config/runtime-users.json (gitignored).
Keyed by login email. Read fresh on every request, so edits apply without a restart.
claudeOauthToken:  node scripts/runtime-user-tool.js encrypt-token '<CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN>'  (optional — omit to use the shared credential)
orchestratorToken: the user's PLAINTEXT orchestrator bearer token (the same one their Claude client uses; config/users.json stores only its sha256 digest)
allowedAgents:     chat agents this user may start besides defaultAgent; a user with super_shannon access can start any non-hidden agent
